inputs/north_one_00_00.scope: All NSC object-centroid aliases in the declared core+halo, no ndetr/rmag/nphotr/filter cut; count-checked meas join and physical-ID dedup. Original SDSS r detections preserved exactly including every physical run. Object labels go only to separate auxiliary labels, not association input. Source identities still require blind association. Halo/object-centroid selection and published-measurement extraction limits remain; actual exposure-cell comparison is separate from image completeness.

year/repeat_sparse.scope: Whole held year excluded from every target band before association. Frozen r-anchor additions and independent no-NSC-r anchor route separated; non-r r magnitudes come from actual SDSS r and are labelled. All bands eligible by physical quality; object IDs never enter training association. One-to-one 1arcsec held matches and four displaced-position controls. Conditional residuals are not absolute dark-star PM truth.
year/repeat_sparse.limitations: Candidate counts only, not adopted reliable stars. Unknown identities/blends are not successes; native W0 shared-night errors are uncalibrated. Footprints of qualified exposures do not prove a faint target had sufficient SNR. Object-centroid/halo retrieval selection remains; the source acquisition receipt identifies whether the historical r-object cut was removed. No adopted full catalogue until independent source/error/zero validation.

Legacy-quality r control and physically filtered r control separate. Independent non-r route cannot include eligible NSC r or share a reserved detection. Same spectral objects compared; all private discovery frozen before spectral lookup. Full ICRS 4x4 and independent/reference tangent components retained. W0 diagonal+50mas does not certify nightly errors or local zero. Counts are research-usable solutions, not purity-certified stars or image completeness. No QSO or faint Gaia motion trains/chooses models; no DCR adopted.
